honesty_notice: Starter frame_readout_time_ms values are estimated from sensor active-row line ratios (IMX510 ~10.3ms for 12.1MP 3:2; IMX710 ~31.8ms for 33MP 3:2), NOT hardware_measured on open-gate card originals. Lens distortion coefficients are zeroed starter placeholders; perform per-lens checkerboard calibration in Gyroflow before final production delivery.
